title: Data Scientist
text:
Data Scientist
Required skills: Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, Statistics.
Minimum 2 years experience. Bachelor degree required.
Responsibilities: Build predictive models, design experiments, explain findings to stakeholders.
Preferred: AWS, Docker, MLflow.
